source: OpenFEMA FIMA NFIP Redacted Claims, dataset NfipClaims version 3

house.filter: (occupancyType eq 1 or occupancyType eq 11) and numberOfFloorsInTheInsuredBuilding eq 1 and foundationType eq '1' and exteriorWaterDepth gt 0 and buildingDamageAmount gt 0

nonres.filter: (occupancyType eq 4 or occupancyType eq 6 or occupancyType eq 18) and numberOfFloorsInTheInsuredBuilding eq 1 and foundationType eq '1' and exteriorWaterDepth gt 0 and buildingDamageAmount gt 0

house_zero.filter: (occupancyType eq 1 or occupancyType eq 11) and numberOfFloorsInTheInsuredBuilding eq 1 and foundationType eq '1' and exteriorWaterDepth gt 0 and buildingDamageAmount eq 0

nonres_2f.filter: (occupancyType eq 4 or occupancyType eq 6 or occupancyType eq 18) and numberOfFloorsInTheInsuredBuilding eq 2 and foundationType eq '1' and exteriorWaterDepth gt 0 and buildingDamageAmount gt 0

nonres_3f.filter: (occupancyType eq 4 or occupancyType eq 6 or occupancyType eq 18) and numberOfFloorsInTheInsuredBuilding eq 3 and foundationType eq '1' and exteriorWaterDepth gt 0 and buildingDamageAmount gt 0

exclusions: cause of damage other than tidal overflow, river overflow or rainfall
zero or missing building replacement cost
depth bands with fewer than 20 claims
depth: exteriorWaterDepth (inches above grade) / 12 minus the reference first-floor height
